structured_output.what_is_happening: TOGI "Togi Coin" (description: "Señor Togi, Fees to @shanestoffer") is a 9-day-old pump.fun coin that has already graduated. Its creator fees are routed to the X account of Shane Stoffer ("TOGI"), a fitness and gambling influencer and Kick streamer with about 98.5k X followers. The coin was dormant, then rose about 2000% in 6 hours, with about $97k of volume in the last hour against an $85k market cap. At detection it was pulling back (-17% over 5 minutes). Since roughly 02:40 UTC, about 8 copycat TOGI tokens have launched. That suggests something Togi-related is happening right now, most likely Togi mentioning or claiming the coin, or a stream. I could not confirm this because X is paywalled to my fetch tool.

narrative.description: A creator-fee coin tied to a real, well-known streamer and influencer (Togi / Shane Stoffer). He has a history of crypto-pump clips, e.g. 'Togi gets sent $100k in a random coin' and 'togi and tjr pumped a random coin'.
narrative.why_spreading: Probably Togi acknowledging the coin or the fees it pays him. The wave of fresh copycat TOGI tickers in the last hour points to a live catalyst, but I found no indexed post to confirm it.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is by far the most liquid and most traded TOGI token ($25.7k liquidity), older than the copycats, and pays its fees to @shanestoffer. GMGN links it to his X account.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Two older 'The Roaring Bull' TOGI tokens (dead). About 8 fresh copycats launched in the last hour: ShaneStoffer, TOGI COIN, TOGICOIN and others, all under $5k market cap. GMGN also counts 320 tokens launched against the X account, so many fee-to-Togi coins exist.

authenticity.evidence: Real influencer with a real audience. Buyer counts are broad (342 unique buyers in the last hour). GMGN flags 309 bundler wallets and a bot/degen rate of 0.78, plus 35 smart wallets and 4 renowned (KOL) wallets. There are no paid DexScreener boosts.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts, so I cannot confirm whether Togi himself promoted the coin or only rando launchers did.

structural_risks: Price is already up 20x in 6 hours and sits near its ATH (about $124k-equivalent). Early buyers are sitting on large gains they may sell.
309 bundler wallets and a high bot share
Two insider transfer networks (9 graph insiders)
The 5-minute trend was turning negative at detection
Copycat tokens are splitting the attention

structured_output.counterargument: If Togi is actively shilling or streaming this coin to 98k+ followers, a creator coin at $85k can easily go to $300k+. The copycat wave shows attention is real and still growing, and LP is burned (lp_burn_ratio 1.0), so a liquidity pull is unlikely.
unknowns: Whether Togi personally posted about or endorsed this CA
Whether the fees are actually being claimed
How much of the volume is bot volume

source_coverage.notes: The X profile returned HTTP 402. A web search on the contract address found nothing. Influencer background came from TikTok, Kick and a bio article. Time-limited.

structured_output.thesis: A plausible influencer creator-coin catalyst with a live copycat wave. But the coin has already run 20x, is near its ATH and was fading at the 5-minute mark, and bundler/bot activity is heavy. That is an above-average but not high chance of another 2x.
